translation.name: Biblica® Ochiw Thuolo Motingʼo Loko Manyien™

content.text: Adier Nyasaye timo maber ni jo-Israel,
otimo maber ne jogo maler ei chunygi.
Anto tiendena nodwaro kier.
Ne achiegni aa kama ne anyono.
Nimar ne agombo timbe joma ochayo ji
kane aneno kaka joma timbegi richo dhi maber.
Gionge gi pek moro amora
kendo dendgi ber kendo otegno.
Chandruok mamako ji gin ok yudgi
kendo ok githagre kaka ji mamoko thagore.
Emomiyo sunga chalonegi thiwni mar ngʼut,
kendo girwako mahundu ka law.
Wengegi onyiedhore gi bor
kendo miriambo maricho mopongʼo pachgi onge gikogi.
Gijaro ji kendo giwuoyo ka gihimo ji,
nikech gichayo ji gisiko gibwogo ji ni ji biro wuoro.
Giwacho weche polo gi dhogi
to lewgi to gimakogo mwandu mag piny.
Emomiyo jogegi doknegi kendo pakogi
kendo ok giyud rach moro amora kuomgi.
Giwacho niya, “Ere kaka Nyasaye nyalo ngʼeyo?
Nyasaye Man Malo Moloyo to ongʼeyo angʼo?”
Kama e kaka joma timbegi richo chalo,
ok gidew gimoro amora kendo mwandugi osiko medore ameda.
Kare asetemo ritora mondo chunya osik kaler kayiem,
kendo asetemo gengʼo lwetena ni kik omul richo kayiem.
Nimar asiko achandora seche duto,
kendo ayudo kum okinyi kokinyi.
Ka dine bed ni awacho kamano,
to dine andhogo nyithindi.
To kane atemo winjo tiend gigi duto,
to ne opek mohinga;
nyaka ne adonjo kama ler mar lemo mar Nyasaye;
eka nawinjo kaka gikogi nobedi.
Chutho iketogi kama poth-poth,
kendo idwokogi piny mi gikethre.
Mano kaka itiekogi apoya nono,
mi masiche malich lal kodgi nono!
Gilal nono ka lek ma ngʼato oleko gokinyi,
omiyo e kinde ma ia malo, yaye Ruoth Nyasaye,
to ok ibi dewogi mana ka kido maonge.
Kane iya owangʼ,
kendo chunya winjo lit,
to pacha nolal kendo ne abedo mofuwo,
ne achalo le maonge rieko e nyimi.
Kata kamano an kodi ndalo duto,
kendo imaka gi bada korachwich.
Itaya gi rieko mingʼadona
kendo bangʼe ibiro tera kar duongʼ.
En ngʼa ma an-go e polo makmana in?
Piny bende onge gi gimoro amora madwaro moloyi.
Ringra gi chunya nyalo doko manyap,
to Nyasaye ema miyo chunya teko,
kendo en e girkeni mara nyaka chiengʼ.
Joma ni mabor kodi biro lal nono
kendo ibiro tieko ji duto ma ok jo-adiera ne in.
An to berna ka an but Nyasaye.
Aseketo Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto kar pondona,
kendo abiro lando gik moko duto mitimo.
